challenge.name: The Consent Gap
challenge.description: A new model version requires loyalty basket data, but the deployment pipeline lacks the governance controls to verify consent. #automation_alex# wants to push the automated deployment forward immediately to meet the promotion deadline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a manual review process to ensure legal compliance. #automation_alex# is open to adding a manual approval step if it keeps the pipeline moving, but #requirements_reuben# will not accept any automated path without full audit trails.

output.content: I am ready to push the new model version through the main deployment pipeline immediately to meet the promotion deadline. I am willing to keep the shadow deployment step done by hand for this release. Accepting that manual burden for the shadow test is the price I will pay to ensure the primary automated path remains unblocked. This compromise allows us to ship on schedule while I handle the verification work personally. I am not asking to remove the shadow test entirely, only to decouple its execution from the automated gate so the main flow does not stall while we sort out the consent checks.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly accepts the burden of manual shadow testing as a cost to keep the automated deployment path unblocked and meet the deadline.
